evaluation_type: descriptive verification of user-fixed current Pine, no optimization or adoption selection
baseline: same current Pine with minCenterPips=0; exact common-period check against previous baseline simulator
data_inputs: hash cached features+manifest, recheck raw Bars.dat stat, truncate every symbol strictly before 2026-08-31 before simulation; preserve pre-start feature warmup
data_quality_scope: confirmed GBPJPY source scale anomaly 2026-08-31 and all later prices OUTSIDE common requested end; no source repair, price scaling or internal row deletion
entry_rules: current Pine defaults: BB20 population3sigma touch preparation, expiry3, close-return confirmation, prior-highlow12/50pip-round impulse1.5ATR/3bar memory and 2xbody/50pct long-wick exclusion; confirmed signal then next available open including gaps
distance_rule: on first otherwise-eligible candidate: side*(confirmedSMA-confirmedClose)/pip+1e-9 < minCenterPips cancels preparation and prevents samebar rearming; do NOT wait for a later distance recovery

exit_rules.reward_risk_ratio: user original moving-center full exit, not fixed RR
exit_rules.target_update: current bar uses previous-confirmed target; update to new SMA only after current fills

positions: one fixed-unit position per symbol, no pyramiding, no exit-bar reentry/preparation
period_semantics: inclusive start/exclusive end, independent flat portfolio per segment; continuous separate; pre-period feature warmup; no forced end liquidation in PF
prior_exposure: previously viewed, not untouched holdout; no selection
cost_and_fill_model: fixed1.4pips and metadata spread/pip+0.2pips; raw OHLC fills; one full cost debit at settlement; open mark subtracts one full cost separately; no swaps/variable spreads/queue/margin
position_sizing_and_currency: one fixed-unit virtual trade per pair; equal-pip aggregate is research score NOT monetary account profit
report_fields: pair/period/model trades wins winrate PF closednet opennet net+open; individual close-MTM and realized DD; distance cancellations; equal-pip aggregate clearly labeled
selection: none; report both fixed conditions in all specified periods without choosing a winner for adoption
acceptance_gates: not an adoption experiment; descriptive completion requires source/stat/hash and baseline reproduction, full accounting and independent audit
cross_symbol_rule: same min0/min5 comparison and common cutoff for all nine; no profitable pair selection
code_identifier: save current Pine, runner, old baseline, protocol, cache and manifest SHA256 before outcomes
stop_rule: exactly two settings; no tuning or expansion after results
